name: Little Millet Lemon Rice
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: 1 tsp each chana dal and urad dal
1 dried red chilli and 8 curry leaves
Juice of 1 lemon, salt and coriander
2 tbsp roasted chana (dalia), crushed, for crunch
100 g firm tofu, crumbled and pan-toasted
steps: Cook the millet in 1 cup water with salt for 12–15 minutes until fluffy and dry. Spread on a plate to cool.
Heat the oil, crackle the mustard, and fry the dals until golden.
Add the red chilli, green chilli, curry leaves and turmeric.
Pour over the millet, add the lemon juice and toss gently.
Toss in the toasted tofu with the lemon juice.
Top with the roasted chana and coriander.
note: Nut-free: roasted chana provides the crunch usually given by peanuts.
